units.translation: There is one example of the perfect ὠπται [has been seen].
which the scholiast explains by τεθεώρηται [has been observed].

Of the aorist middle εἰδόμην [I saw], the imperative ἰδοῦ [behold!] (two examples of which we cited above from Ch. 230, 247), with a change of accent, passed into the adverb of one pointing out or bidding to attend, idού [behold!], corresponding to the Latin ecce or en.
